events.text: Maybank's sustainable finance disclosures for the period 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2024 have been subjected to an independent limited assurance by PricewaterhouseCoopers PLT, Malaysia (PwC).

Bank Negara Malaysia imposed an Administrative Monetary Penalty of RM4,320,000 on Malayan Banking Berhad and Maybank Islamic Berhad on 29 July 2024 for non-compliance with paragraph 48(1)(a) of the Financial Services Act 2013 and paragraph 58(1)(a) of the Islamic Financial Services Act 2013.
Bank Negara Malaysia fined Maybank Islamic Bhd RM1.2 million for failing to comply with financial services laws.
